messages:
ana: deploy-bot flagged eu-central canary: multiple pods in payments-service are stuck ImagePullBackOff after chart bump. saw this at 09:14 UTC.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2025-02-10T09:12:30Z by tom/gh:PR#5890. Canary fraction 10% -> 30%. Observed failures: ImagePullBackOff (digest mismatch) on payments-service:tag v2025-02-10. Registry returned 404 for digest sha256:deadbeef.

tom: that's the new multi-arch build. CI passed but registry promotion job maybe failed. Can we pin back to previous digest or roll back the release?

linda: pinning to previous digest is safest if we can fetch it. rollback would drop unrelated fixes in this deploy (there's a configmap change we need). We could hotpatch image to previous digest and resume rollout.

ana: (typo) ana: +1 to hotpatch image. how long to verify the digest exists in eu-central registry mirror? ops, can you check?

ops: checking mirror... mirror shows previous digest sha256:c0ffeec0 present in eu-central. Retries to registry timing out for the new digest. Looks like promotion pipeline didn't push v2025-02-10 to eu-central, only to us-east.

linda: ok plan: kubectl -n payments set image deploy/payments-service payments=registry.internal/payments@sha256:c0ffeec0 && kubectl -n payments rollout status deploy/payments-service -w. Then pause auto-promote to prod until we confirm registry promotion fix.

tom: running the hotpatch now. command: ```kubectl -n payments set image deploy/payments-service payments=registry.internal/payments@sha256:c0ffeec0```

deploy-bot: Received manual image override for deploy 2025-02-10T09:12:30Z. Applying patch and pausing forward promotion. Auto-rollback policy remains enabled for health regressions.

ana: (typo again) ana: small nit — can we also pin the chart-version in values for this release so the auto-upgrader doesn't reapply tag-only promotions?

linda: will add a chart pin in the release metadata. Also adding a note to release-notes: "Hotpatch: revert to previous payments image digest in eu-central due to incomplete registry promotion; follow-up: resume image promotion pipeline."

tom: after hotpatch, health checks passing and new pods running. no more ImagePullBackOff.

ops: metric check: pod restarts zero, requests served back to baseline. I'll open a short incident ticket (INC-2025-112) to track registry promotion SKUs and add a deploy preflight check to validate per-region digest presence before increasing canary fraction.

linda: re: rollback vs pin decision — we chose pin/hotpatch to avoid losing unrelated config fixes. leaving auto-rollback enabled for future regressions.

ana: (typo) ana: minor ops ask: add a checklist item in release notes template for multi-region registry promotion status.

deploy-bot: Noted. Paused promotion for deploy 2025-02-10T09:12:30Z. Manual resume required: `deploy-bot resume 2025-02-10T09:12:30Z` once registry promotion confirmed.

tom: thanks all. I'll follow up with the build infra team to ensure promotion job reports per-region success and fail loudly.

linda: adding changelog entry and the release note hotpatch line now. Also creating a small helm lint rule to detect tag-only changes without digest for future. :memo:
